because: Deterministic phrase rules for the pre-post editorial gate. ptgae-* rules are copied by pattern from the public MIT repository red-cup-engineering/ptgae-prose-analysis-service (src/analyze.mjs, rules PTG001-PTG044 that apply to short public prose) and from the Plain Technical General American English standard's 'tonal poison' list. The other categories are this list's own and are maintained here: a phrase belongs on the list when it states no checkable fact. A match is a refusal to post, not a rewrite: the author states the claim, names the measure, or removes the sentence.
severity: refuse blocks the post; note is reported and does not block

rules.pattern: \b(?:it is important to note(?: that)?|it is worth noting(?: that)?|it should be noted that|it is worth mentioning(?: that)?)\b
rules.message: State the proposition without throat-clearing.
Use one uncertainty mechanism.
State the proposal directly.
Prefer 'to'.
Prefer the direct verb.
Name the measure or consequence.
State the bounded implication directly.
Use a claim status (Hypothesis, Unknown) instead.
Prefer 'because'.
Prefer 'can'.

rules.pattern: \b(?:there is|there are)\s+(?:a number of|several different|various different)\b
rules.message: Name the items or give the count.
State what the subject does.
Name the old model, the new model and the changed consequence.
Name the items or the count.
Name the tested reliability and scale.
State the future rule, action or date.
Name the unanswered question or the next measurement.
Generic scaffold; state the actual work.
Hype word. Say what it does and how it was measured.

rules.pattern: \b(?:supercharge[sd]?|turbocharge[sd]?|skyrocket(?:s|ed|ing)?|unlock(?:s|ed|ing)? (?:the )?(?:power|potential|value)|harness(?:es|ed|ing)? the power|empower(?:s|ed|ing)?|disrupt(?:s|ed|ing)?|transform(?:s|ed|ing)? the way|take[sn]? .{0,20} to the next level|elevate[sd]? your)\b
rules.message: Hype verb. State the concrete effect.

rules.pattern: \b(?:(?:we(?:'re| are)|i(?:'m| am)) (?:so |very |truly |incredibly )?(?:excited|thrilled|delighted|proud|pleased|honou?red) (?:to|that)|stay tuned|big news|huge news|exciting news|check it out|don't miss|dont miss|you won't believe|you wont believe|act now|limited time|going viral|must[- ]read|must[- ]see|a must[- ]have)\b
rules.message: Announcement voice. Say what changed.
Absolute claim. State the tested bound.

rules.pattern: \b(?:trusted by|used by (?:thousands|millions|hundreds|teams|companies|developers)|loved by|customers love|our (?:happy )?customers|thousands of (?:users|customers|developers)|millions of (?:users|customers|developers)|fast[- ]growing|rapidly growing|award[- ]winning|industry[- ]recognized|widely (?:used|adopted)|leading (?:provider|platform|solution|company))\b
rules.message: Social-proof claim with no stated source. Cite a count and a date, or remove it.
Superlative or priority claim. Cite the comparison or remove it.

rules.pattern: \b(?:like and subscribe|follow (?:for|4) follow|f4f|rt if|retweet if|repost if|share if you|tag (?:a )?friends?|drop a (?:comment|like)|smash (?:that|the) (?:like|button)|link in bio|dm (?:me )?for|giveaway|upvote (?:this|us)|vote for us|support us on product hunt|comment below|what do you think\?|thoughts\?|agree\?)
rules.message: Engagement request. Platform rules and our own rule bar asking for engagement.

rules.pattern: \b(?:in today's (?:fast[- ]paced|digital|ever[- ]changing|rapidly evolving)|in an (?:era|age|world) (?:where|of)|in the (?:ever[- ]evolving|ever[- ]changing) (?:world|landscape)|navigat(?:e|ing) the (?:complex )?landscape|at the end of the day|when it comes to|let's dive in|let us dive in|buckle up|here's the thing|here is the thing)\b
rules.message: Stock opener that carries no information.

rules.pattern: \b(?:delv(?:e|es|ed|ing) (?:into|deeper)|tapestry|testament to|myriad|plethora|multifaceted|nuanced (?:approach|understanding)|holistic(?:ally)?|synerg(?:y|ies|istic)|seamless(?:ly)?|leverag(?:e|es|ed|ing)(?! (?:the )?(?:buying|debt|financial))|robust(?:ly)? (?:solution|framework|platform|system)|ecosystem of|realm of|beacon of|embark(?:s|ed|ing)? on a journey|journey (?:towards|to)|pave[sd]? the way|foster(?:s|ed|ing)? (?:a )?(?:culture|innovation|collaboration)|underscor(?:e|es|ed|ing)|pivotal|game-?changer|cornerstone of|stands as a|a testament)\b
rules.message: Stock vocabulary. Use the plain word or name the specific thing.
Contrast frame with no content. State the claim.

rules.pattern: \b(?:in conclusion|in summary|to sum up|to summarize|all in all|ultimately,|the bottom line is|the future (?:of \w+ )?is (?:bright|here)|only time will tell|the possibilities are endless|the sky(?:'s| is) the limit)\b
rules.message: Closing filler. End when the information ends.

rules.pattern: \b(?:it(?:'s| is) worth (?:noting|mentioning|remembering)|it(?:'s| is) (?:important|crucial|essential|vital) to (?:note|remember|understand|recognize|consider)|needless to say|that being said|that said,|having said that|with that in mind)\b
rules.message: Hedging connective. Delete or state the point.
Business metric or audience claim. The Group has no customer, revenue or audience evidence in any primary source; say what exists, with the page that shows it.

limits-note: Emoji, exclamation marks, hashtags, dash density and readability are measured in code, not by phrase.
